problem: The sharp zoom path spent work filtering invisible pan margins and repeatedly uploading expanded regions, delaying visible scale updates.
implementation: During scale changes, render only visible display pixels; restore pan margins after 120 ms without a scale change.
On a required worker upload, admit bounded linear source padding for nearby zoom scales, without rendering those invisible pixels.
Copy source rows directly into the mapped GPU buffer using existing bytemuck on little-endian hosts, with explicit big-endian packing; retain validation and memory/completion leases.
Render pan immediately after zoom from resident input; otherwise hold the previous complete placement until coverage is ready.
Ship the measured release application (opt-level 3, thin LTO), retaining the previously verified isolated worker.

options_considered.option: Visible-only presentation during zoom and bounded source anticipation
options_considered.reason: Addresses the measured dominant worker contention and excessive pixel count while keeping canonical filters and native detail.
Eliminates a source-sized temporary vector and per-channel packing on little-endian hosts; the intermediate experiment and final run show much shorter upload-related worker preparation.

Immediate UI-thread encode/submit elapsed time was about 1 ms in the baseline, far below the observed 200+ ms stalls. Pooling adds in-flight ownership and quota complexity; no measured pool-speedup claim.
Large native RAW inputs exceed common single-storage-buffer capabilities and multiply optional GPU memory. Regional residency preserves existing quotas.

options_considered.option: Lower LOD or cheaper filter during the gesture
options_considered.reason: Would reintroduce the reported blur or change the canonical sampling contract.
Measured separately from the algorithmic comparison; native surface correctness is verified again on the installed release binary.

measurement.sequence: 120 requested scales: 100% to 200%, down to 37%, back to 100%; requests paced at least 16 ms apart. Timer starts after canonical native preview readiness. No CPU references or surface readback during the measured gesture.
measurement.files: 18 MP JPEG and 24 MP Nikon D750 NEF (TrueRendererExperimental), with JPEG also tested in forced CPU mode.
measurement.viewport: approximately 855 x 596 backing pixels; exact dimensions recorded in each run
measurement.statistics: Per-run software draw/visible-scale intervals; summary uses the median of three per-run statistics. These are not physical display FPS or event-to-photon latencies.
measurement.baseline_profile: dev opt-level 1, dependencies opt-level 2; installed implementation plus the same counters and no-readback probe
measurement.algorithm_comparison_profile: same dev optimization settings; intermediate source snapshot before a final guard restricting zoom bookkeeping to view lanes, leaving the measured viewer path unchanged
measurement.release_profile: opt-level 3, thin LTO, stripped debug information; worker unchanged
